subject: general
question: Bijapur was annexed by Aurangzeb in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1686**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bijapur **was **annexed in by Aurangzeb** in **1686**.
 
• But their control of the region began to weaken after **Aurangzeb’s **death in **1707**.
 
• Maratha Empire further weakened the Mughals and their Nawabs in the region through massive onslaughts and raids.
 
• Eventually, **Bijapur and much of the Deccan was no longer under the control of Mughal by 1753. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Aurangzeb **

 
 
• **The Mughal emperor Aurangzeb was known as Abul Muzaffar Muhi-ud-Din Muhammad Aurangzeb, commonly known as Aurangzeb or by his regional title Alamgir**.
 
• Mohi-ud-din Mohammed Aurangzeb was born on Oct. 24, 1618, in Dohad and was the third son of Emperor Shah Jahan.
 
• Aurangzeb (1658-1707) was the sixth Mogul emperor of India and after his death, the downfall of Mughals started.
 
• He extended the Mogul Empire to its farthest boundaries, but his reign was harsh and marked by revolts.
 
• He ruled over most of the Indian subcontinent during some parts of his reign, which lasted for 49 years from 1658 until he died in 1707.
 
• Mughal emperor Aurangzeb died in 1707 after a 49-year reign without officially declaring a crown prince.
